provenance.source: Bounded read-only collector events/vehicles plus current exact-stop timetable and projected fleet metadata.
provenance.selection: 30 deliberately varied real base observations, not a representative random sample; chosen order is an audition sequence, not chronological history.
provenance.overlays: Weather replay, synthetic traffic and preselected editorial fact are individually labelled; never publish these outputs.
provenance.identity: Vehicle, run and trip identifiers pseudonymised; no raw fleet file, credentials, coordinates or operator-host paths.
